# NEW 2026-11-22 v12.5 Worker 3: Condottieri Contracts, Free Company Mutiny Disaster & Gunpowder Logistics Reform (oe_mer2_, 0 slots, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v125_mercenaries.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Dynamic Disaster: Free Company Mutiny (repeatable disaster; fire_only_once = no).
oe_mer2_free_company_mutiny = {
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/disaster/robber_barons_troubles.dds"
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_medium
	fire_only_once = no

	can_start = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_subject = no
		has_any_active_disaster = no
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_mer2_mutiny_cooldown }
		NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_mer2_standing_army_reformed }
		OR = {
			oe_mer2_risk_at_least_40 = yes
			any_hired_mercenary = { count >= 3 }
		}
		OR = {
			is_during_bankruptcy = yes
			num_loans >= 4
			gold < 0
			AND = {
				at_war = no
				war_exhaustion >= 8
				stability < 15
			}
		}
	}

	can_end = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				is_during_bankruptcy = no
				stability >= 25
				OR = {
					has_country_modifier = oe_mer2_standing_army_reformed
					AND = {
						NOT = { any_hired_mercenary = { count >= 1 } }
						oe_mer2_risk_at_most_10 = yes
					}
				}
			}
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_mer2_mutiny_months }
				var:oe_mer2_mutiny_months >= 120
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
	}

	modifier = {
		mercenary_maintenance_efficiency = -0.40
		hire_mercenary_premium_cost_modifier = 0.60
		monthly_rebel_growth = 0.006
		global_monthly_prosperity = -0.005
		tax_income_efficiency = -0.15
		discipline = -0.05
		stability_cost_efficiency = -0.25
	}

	on_start = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_mer2_mutiny_active value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_mer2_mutiny_months value = 0 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mer2.1
	}

	on_monthly = {
		random_list = {
			6 = { custom_tooltip = an_event_occurs_tt }
			94 = { custom_tooltip = no_event_occurs_tt }
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_mer2_mutiny_months }
				change_variable = { name = oe_mer2_mutiny_months add = 1 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { name = oe_mer2_mutiny_months value = 1 }
			}
			random_list = {
				94 = { }
				2 = { trigger_event_silently = oe_mer2.2 }
				2 = { trigger_event_silently = oe_mer2.3 }
				1 = { trigger_event_silently = oe_mer2.4 }
				1 = { trigger_event_silently = oe_mer2.5 }
			}
		}
	}

	on_end = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_mer2_mutiny_active }
			remove_variable = oe_mer2_mutiny_active
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_mer2_mutiny_months }
			remove_variable = oe_mer2_mutiny_months
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_mer2_arrears_risk value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_mer2_mutiny_cooldown value = 1 years = 25 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mer2.7
	}
}
